title: End of Day
intro: A few gentle questions to close the day. Answer in your head or jot a note. Skip any you like.

prompts.text: What is one thing you finished today, however small?
What took more effort than you expected?
What would you like to leave for tomorrow?
Is there anything you can set down for now?
prompts.followUp: A quick note to yourself can hold it until morning.

prompts.text: What was a good moment from the day?
What is one small thing that would make tomorrow's start easier?
How would you like the evening to feel?
What is one thing you want to remember about today?
